name: Priya Mehta
text: Amazing flavors and service! The butter chicken was absolutely divine and the staff made us feel like family.

name: Rajesh Kumar
text: Best Indian restaurant in town! The biryani is authentic and the naan is always fresh and warm. Highly recommend!

name: Anita Desai
text: Loved the vegetarian options and the mango lassi was refreshing. Great ambiance and attentive service.

name: Michael Chen
text: Celebrated our anniversary here and it was perfect. The lamb rogan josh was exceptional and the service was impeccable.
